entries.title: Internal data-only domain-pack and consumer preview
entries.summary: Add strict domain-pack inputs, explicit all-section content pins, conservative migration reports and a read-only scoped consumer; four fictional catalogues use the unchanged kernel without launching another product.
added: Versioned bounded JSON pack schema/loader with native graph/action/policy contracts, vocabulary, mappings, explicit confirmation rules, inert prompts and host-registered integration declarations.

Neutral/sales/support fictional reuse fixtures and an exact export of the existing product-owned supplier playbook; detached current-authority scoped read-only consumer and conservative review-only migrations.
Source-isolated consumer and negative tests, distribution/ownership documentation, exact lane receipt and complete emergence review.
verification: 95 focused tests passed (59 domain-pack + 36 retained kernel); 1415 full source tests passed with one upstream Starlette/AnyIO deprecation warning.

Python compilation and all 18 browser-module syntax checks passed. Ten original native browser suites completed with 352 checks; Studio failed the frozen newest-changelog local-unreleased assertion, with no bridge or fake pass.

Existing internal-wheel smoke passed; full installed-wheel regressions FAILED collection because the integration-owned package manifest omits the new subpackage. Initial setup/focused failures and corrected commands are retained in the receipt.
limitations: Source-only internal engineering preview, not complete ES04/ES10 or native/package acceptance. Integrator must include endstate.domain_packs in the frozen manifest, reconcile truthful changelog/test state and rerun combined native acceptance.

No current transactional production isolation, async cancellation fencing, real model/professional/human acceptance, second application, public SDK/API/MCP, connector execution, automatic case migration, licence/support commitment or independent release approval.
No shared/canonical tracking edits in this builder; lane-local fragments need serial integration and regeneration.

discoveries: A canonical all-section pack digest can detect changes to prompts, policies and adapter declarations, but neither a digest nor a caller subject authenticates a consumer. The read-only consumer needs independently host-authenticated identity, current scoped grants and a fresh revision-bound snapshot; local bearer identity, cross-scope requests and post-read revocation are rejected in focused tests.

The support reuse fixture originally had confirmed policy state. A reusable pack must reject that state, while a live host snapshot may independently record manual policy review. Focused tests show that review alone still cannot satisfy an unobserved authority predicate, and that unrelated catalogue changes fail review matching.

The frozen setuptools manifest lists only endstate. The internal wheel smoke passes but omits endstate.domain_packs; the actual installed-wheel regression run fails test collection with ModuleNotFoundError. Source-isolated reuse and 1415 source tests therefore do not prove this preview ships. No top-level LICENSE/LICENCE file or independent release approval was found/created in this checkpoint.
risks: Pack declarations or hashes mistaken for host authority, executable integration registration or verified facts.
Source-only packaging success mistaken for distribution/release or complete native acceptance.
architecture_implications: Keep data-only templates detached from source-backed case state; host injects current-authority/scoped reads and retains transactional commits.
Package manifest and canonical tracking are integration-owned; no automatic public exposure or live migrations.
emergence_review.roadmap_decision: existing_task / decision_record only for ES04-01..04 and ES10-01..02; preserve all prerequisite, human, licence/support and independent release gates. No new required tasks.
